facts.business: Polymechplast Machines Limited manufactures and sells plastic processing machinery.

auditor.name: Devesh Pathak & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Delay of one day in submission of disclosure of Related Party Transactions to the stock exchange beyond prescribed timelines pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of LODR for half year ended 30th September 2025; fine of Rs. 5000 + GST Rs. 900 paid on 5th January 2026.

facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables from related parties were Rs. 1.06 lakhs as at 31st March 2025 and nil as at 31st March 2026. Delay in disclosure of Related Party Transactions for half year ended 30th September 2025 resulted in fine of Rs. 5000 + GST Rs. 900.
